'''Dervin''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Dervin was one of the [[Vault 32 raider]]s who, under [[Lee Moldaver]]'s orders, infiltrated [[Vault 32]] and participated in the Triennial Trade with Vault 33.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
Sometime after being imprisoned with his fellow Vault 32 raiders in a room within Vault 33, Dervin and his fellow raiders are served trays of food by [[Marianne (TV series)|Marianne]].

During a meeting led by the Vault 33 Council with the Vault 33 dwellers about the Vault 32 raiders, Dervin is seen scarfing down a tray of food served to him and his fellow raiders.

===[[The Ghouls]]===
Dervin could be seen through the window when Norm was ordered to deliver a jello cake to the Vault 32 raiders. After some slices were passed through the door hatch, the remainder of the cake was taken by [[Veronica (TV series)|Veronica]]. Through the hatch on the door, Dervin interacts with Norm, asking what he's looking at, to which he answers, a murderer in a cage who took the innocent lives of Vault 33 and 32 dwellers. The '''dirigible squire''' is a character who appears in the second episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
This [[Squire (TV series)|squire]] is a member of the [[Knights of San Fernando]] in 2296, and was part of the force stationed on the ''[[Caswennan]]'' during the chapter's move to claim [[Area 51]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Golden Rule]]===
After [[Maximus]] returns to the ''Caswennan'' from his mission to a [[shadowy facility]], he hands over the [[control panel]] he obtained from the facility to [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]]; the squire is seen standing by at a nearby console. Quintus then hands the control panel to the squire, who brings it to the console and plugs it in.

The squire then sends light signals to two Brotherhood scribes on the ground, signaling them to activate the machine that will uncover Area 51, and watches as the sand dunes blanketing Area 51 are blown away by the wind turbines.

==Appearances==
The dirigible squire appears only {{In|FOTV}}.
